_comment_paths: @classconnect/shared is deliberately NOT mapped to ../../packages/shared/src. Turbopack applies these paths to every module it compiles, including the already-compiled CommonJS Nest app that /api/v1/[...path] boots. Pointed at the source, the shared barrel is rebuilt as ESM; zod is an external, so the barrel becomes an async module, and a synchronous require of an async module returns its exports before they exist. Every zodBody(schema) then captures undefined and every validated endpoint 500s. Left unmapped, it resolves through the workspace symlink to dist/index.js — the CommonJS the API prebuild's tsc -b already produces — and both hosts load the identical artefact.
_comment_exclude: Tests need the jest globals and jest-dom matchers, which the app build has no business knowing about. They are type-checked by tsconfig.spec.json, which the root typecheck script also runs. Kept as a string rather than a // comment because Next.js parses this file and it was strict JSON before.
